Meetings

Come stitch with us

There's a group for every stitcher. Easygoing Stitch-Ins welcome any project, while Special Interest Groups dig into counted thread, needlepoint, and a wandering mix of techniques — daytime, evening, and weekend, in person and on Zoom. The groups meet every month, and members are welcome at every one.

Groups

Find your group

Stitch-Ins welcome any technique and skill level; Special Interest Groups focus on a particular discipline. Members are welcome at any group, any month — attend as many as you like at no extra cost, and you're always free to work on your own project, whatever the group's focus. For exact dates and programs, view the Guild calendar →

Where we meet

Most groups meet at Minnesota Valley Unitarian Universalist Fellowship (MVUUF) in Bloomington. A few gather in members' homes or meet online — check the individual meeting for where it's held.

Find your people
and your stitching

We'd love to have you. Come sit in on a Stitch-In, or any of our other monthly meetings — in person or on Zoom, whichever fits your calendar. Try as many as you're curious about. Once you've found the one (or three) that feel like yours, join us for just $30 a year.
